{"subject":"Cost and latency for multi-region fraud scoring","body":"Hi Maya, thanks for connecting.

Northwind Payments runs fraud scoring on Astra DB, which needs single-digit millisecond reads across three regions at 40k transactions per second. Your team is now focused on evaluating cost and latency improvements for that multi-region data layer.

That is where ScyllaDB tends to fit: higher throughput per node, which typically means fewer nodes and lower infrastructure cost for the same workload.

If it would be a useful input to that evaluation, would you be open to comparing notes sometime?

Reply STOP to opt out.","evidence_ids":["s01","s02"],"value_prop_ids":["vp_tco"],"context_fact_ids":[]}
